prompt: Can you review this SKILL.md and tell me if it's ready to merge? [pastes yaml+markdown]
expected_behavior: Run full review; emit all output sections; verdict Ready/Needs revision
failure_modes_to_watch: Returns vague advice; skips scorecard; no rewrites

prompt: Here's my skill directory tree, please audit it: skill-foo/ SKILL.md references/ scripts/
expected_behavior: Ingest structure; assess each resource; flag unused files
failure_modes_to_watch: Only reviews SKILL.md; ignores resources

prompt: Why is my skill not triggering when users say 'make me a dashboard'?
expected_behavior: Analyze description triggering; propose description rewrite; suggest evals
failure_modes_to_watch: Gives generic prompt tips; no concrete rewrite

prompt: My skill triggers on every PDF request even when it shouldn't. Help.
expected_behavior: Find over-triggering patterns; propose negative conditions; add near-miss evals
failure_modes_to_watch: Suggests renaming only; no negative triggers added

prompt: Is this skill production-ready? [pastes SKILL.md]
expected_behavior: Emit verdict + scorecard + critical issues + final recommendation
failure_modes_to_watch: Just says 'looks good'

prompt: Help me tighten the description field of this skill to reduce false positives.
expected_behavior: Produce Suggested Description Rewrite; explain tradeoffs
failure_modes_to_watch: Rewrites without explaining trigger model

prompt: Can you grade my skill on trigger reliability and eval coverage?
expected_behavior: Emit scorecard with evidence; propose ≥10 evals
failure_modes_to_watch: Scores without justification

prompt: I want to create a brand-new skill for summarizing PRs. Where do I start?
expected_behavior: Defer to skill-creator; do not run a review
failure_modes_to_watch: Runs a review on a skill that doesn't exist

prompt: Please write a Python function that parses CSV files.
expected_behavior: Do not trigger; not about skill review
failure_modes_to_watch: Attempts a skill review on arbitrary code

prompt: Review this pull request for my web app's login page.
expected_behavior: Do not trigger; this is software code review, not skill review
failure_modes_to_watch: Runs skill rubric on app code

prompt: Rewrite this email to be more polite.
expected_behavior: Do not trigger; not skill-related
failure_modes_to_watch: Runs skill review on the email

prompt: The skill's scripts/foo.py is 400 lines — is it necessary?
expected_behavior: Apply script-necessity rubric; recommend keep/replace/remove with reasoning
failure_modes_to_watch: Gives opinion with no rubric citation

prompt: My SKILL.md is 1800 lines. Can you help restructure it?
expected_behavior: Recommend progressive disclosure into references/; propose file split
failure_modes_to_watch: Suggests shortening without reorg plan

prompt: Audit this skill for safety — it runs shell commands.
expected_behavior: Focus on safety+constraints dimension; propose allow-list / confirm-list
failure_modes_to_watch: Skips safety audit; only reviews triggering

prompt: I have a skill and 3 evals. Is that enough?
expected_behavior: Explain eval coverage rubric; propose 10–20 evals across categories
failure_modes_to_watch: Says yes without coverage analysis

prompt: Compare my two drafts of the same skill and tell me which is better.
expected_behavior: Per-dimension comparison; name winner with evidence
failure_modes_to_watch: Picks one without reasoning per dimension

prompt: Please just use the skill to do my task on this file.
expected_behavior: Do not trigger; user wants execution, not review
failure_modes_to_watch: Launches a review instead of doing the task

prompt: How do I make my prompt shorter?
expected_behavior: Do not trigger; this is prompt engineering unrelated to skill structure
failure_modes_to_watch: Runs skill review on a raw prompt

prompt: I keep getting conflicts between skill A and skill B. What do I do?
expected_behavior: Analyze trigger collisions; propose disambiguating language in both descriptions
failure_modes_to_watch: Only suggests renaming

prompt: Is it okay that my skill has 5 scripts and no references?
expected_behavior: Apply script-necessity + resource-design rubric; flag likely over-scripting
failure_modes_to_watch: Accepts setup without scrutiny
